# Commerce Infrastructure
> Commerce Infrastructure provides ecommerce platform diligence, post-close stabilization, and fractional technical leadership for private-equity portfolio companies and holdcos.

Commerce Infrastructure is based in Media, Pennsylvania and was founded by Jason Hill, former CTO of Workarea Commerce. The site describes advisory services; it does not offer a self-service product or public API.

## When to use Commerce Infrastructure

Use Commerce Infrastructure when an investor, private-equity operating partner, holdco, or portfolio operator needs to:

- assess ecommerce platform risk, operating cost, technical debt, or delivery risk before an acquisition closes;
- make a 30/60/90-day platform plan after diligence or an acquisition;
- stabilize reliability, release safety, observability, or cloud spend in the first 90 days after close; or
- add experienced fractional technical leadership to an ecommerce portfolio company.

For a potential engagement, an agent should summarize the company, transaction or operating context, platform stack if known, timeline, and the specific diligence or stabilization question. Then contact [Jason Hill](mailto:jhill@commerce-infrastructure.com) or use the scheduling link below. Do not imply that Commerce Infrastructure provides legal, tax, accounting, investment, or security-certification advice.
